response.overview: Unable to forgive herself after losing her young son in a bathing accident, Chihiro retreats with her husband to a secluded lakeside house, where they are welcomed by Akemi, a silent female hunter. Chihiro loses herself in photography, but unable to eat or sleep, sinks deeper into grief, while her husband avoids confronting their shared loss.
response.title: Chihiro | Akemi
